raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
### What does this PR do?

`actor_rollout_ref.rollout.full_determinism=true` does not work with the default vLLM compile mode on the pinned stack (vllm 0.29.0, torch 2.13). The vLLM engine fails during startup:

```
torch._inductor.exc.InductorError: RuntimeError: In the deterministic mode of Inductor, we will avoid those
benchmarkings that would cause non-deterministic results. ...
  scheduler.py create_combo_kernel_nodes -> speedup_by_combo_kernel -> benchmark_fused_nodes -> may_ban_benchmarking
RuntimeError: Engine core initialization failed.
```

**Cause:**
1. `enable_full_determinism()` runs in the vLLM server and calls `torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)`. That call also sets `torch._inductor.config.deterministic = True`.
2. In this mode Inductor refuses to benchmark kernels.
3. vLLM before v0.32 sets `inductor_compile_config["benchmark_combo_kernel"] = True` unconditionally on torch >= 2.9, so `torch.compile` of the model aborts.

vLLM fixed this upstream in vllm-project/vllm#59074, which turns off combo-kernel benchmarking in deterministic mode. That fix first ships in v0.32.0, so 0.29 (pinned) and 0.30 (#8072) are both affected. The determinism tests in this repo all set `enforce_eager=true`, so CI does not exercise the compile path. The setup in `docs/advance/determinism.md` does not mention `enforce_eager`, so users following it hit the crash.

**Fix:** when `full_determinism` is on, the vLLM server sets `combo_kernels=True, benchmark_combo_kernel=False` in `compilation_config.inductor_compile_config`, the same values vLLM >= 0.32 chooses itself. If the user already set either key through `engine_kwargs.vllm.compilation_config`, it is left alone. Nothing changes when `full_determinism` is off.

**Not a duplicate:** I searched issues and PRs for `full_determinism`, `deterministic mode of Inductor` and `benchmark_combo_kernel`. The open ones (#7667, #8026) cover routing and actor-side batch invariance, not this startup failure.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs. Paste at least one query link here: https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=full_determinism
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}` (This will be checked by the CI)

### Test

**CPU tests:** `tests/workers/rollout/test_vllm_cli_args_on_cpu.py` gains `TestApplyDeterministicInductorDefaults`, which covers the defaults, preserving other inductor options, and user settings winning.

```
pytest -q tests/workers/rollout/test_vllm_cli_args_on_cpu.py
# 38 passed
```

**GPU runs:** 1x RTX 4090, main @ 3c6d9b4, vllm 0.29.0, torch 2.13. Qwen3-0.6B, GSM8K GRPO, batch 32 × n=4, 2 steps, following the setup in `docs/advance/determinism.md`: `rollout.full_determinism=true`, `trainer.use_v1=false`, and actor/ref `fsdp_config.full_determinism=true`. Each config ran twice; the values below are step 1 / step 2.

| config | starts | `critic/score/mean` | `response_length/mean` | `rollout_probs_diff_mean` | run 1 vs run 2 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| main, compile mode | no (InductorError above) | – | – | – | – |
| main, `enforce_eager=true` | yes | 0.0625 / 0.21875 | 492.3125 / 463.0625 | 0.005955675151 / 0.006048386917 | identical |
| this PR, compile mode | yes | 0.03125 / 0.21875 | 500.53125 / 471.4375 | 0.005736875348 / 0.005824934691 | identical |

The V1 trainer fails the same way. Its separate reproducibility limitations are already documented.

### Design & Code Changes

- `verl/workers/rollout/vllm_rollout/utils.py`: new `apply_deterministic_inductor_defaults(compilation_config)`.
- `verl/workers/rollout/vllm_rollout/vllm_async_server.py`: call it while building `compilation_config` when `config.full_determinism` is set.

Once verl moves to vLLM >= 0.32, the helper is a no-op in effect, since vLLM picks the same values, and it can be removed.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [ ] Read the [Contribute Guide](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Apply [pre-commit checks](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-linting-and-formatting): `pre-commit install && pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure --color=always`
- [ ] Add / Update [the documentation](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/tree/main/docs).
- [x] Add unit or end-to-end test(s) to [the CI workflow](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/tree/main/.github/workflows) to cover all the code. If not feasible, explain why: `tests/workers/rollout/test_vllm_cli_args_on_cpu.py` (runs in the vLLM workflow).
- [ ] Once your PR is ready for CI, send a message in [the `ci-request` channel](https://verl-project.slack.com/archives/C091TCESWB1) in [the `verl` Slack workspace](https://join.slack.com/t/verl-project/shared_invite/zt-3855yhg8g-CTkqXu~hKojPCmo7k_yXTQ). (If not accessible, please try [the Feishu group (飞书群)](https://applink.larkoffice.com/client/chat/chatter/add_by_link?link_token=772jd4f1-cd91-441e-a820-498c6614126a).)

+class TestApplyDeterministicInductorDefaults:
+    """full_determinism must not leave vLLM benchmarking combo kernels under Inductor's deterministic mode."""
+
+    def test_sets_combo_kernels_without_benchmarking(self):
+        config = {"cudagraph_mode": "FULL_AND_PIECEWISE"}

+        }
+

+        config = {"inductor_compile_config": {"max_autotune": False}}
+        apply_deterministic_inductor_defaults(config)
+        assert config["inductor_compile_config"] == {
+            "max_autotune": False,
+            "combo_kernels": True,
+            "benchmark_combo_kernel": False,
+        }
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
+        "user_config", [{"combo_kernels": False}, {"benchmark_combo_kernel": True}, {"combo_kernels": True}]
+    )
+    def test_user_combo_kernel_settings_win(self, user_config):
+        config = {"inductor_compile_config": dict(user_config)}
+        apply_deterministic_inductor_defaults(config)
+        assert config["inductor_compile_config"] == user_config

@@ -116,6 +116,22 @@ def get_vllm_max_lora_rank(lora_rank: int):
             return rank
 
 
+def apply_deterministic_inductor_defaults(compilation_config: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    """Keep vLLM's torch.compile path working under full determinism.
+
+    ``enable_full_determinism`` calls ``torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)``, which also sets
+    ``torch._inductor.config.deterministic``. Inductor then refuses to benchmark kernels, but vLLM before
+    v0.32 turns on ``benchmark_combo_kernel`` unconditionally on torch >= 2.9, so engine startup fails with
+    "In the deterministic mode of Inductor, we will avoid those benchmarkings ...". Mirror the upstream fix
+    (vllm-project/vllm#59074): keep combo kernels but skip their benchmarking. User-provided values win.
+    """
+    inductor_compile_config = compilation_config.setdefault("inductor_compile_config", {})
+    if "combo_kernels" in inductor_compile_config or "benchmark_combo_kernel" in inductor_compile_config:
+        return
+    inductor_compile_config["combo_kernels"] = True
+    inductor_compile_config["benchmark_combo_kernel"] = False
+
